_comment: Selectable account identities for the frontend account picker, chosen to span the whole history-depth range so a demo can show the cold-start and rich-history paths side by side. /api/sample-users reads this and computes each account's live post count from the corpus; the recorded history_depth is what history_depth_name() returns for that count. Deliberately separate from demo_accounts.json, which must stay absent so /api/demo-users keeps answering [].
